ad_library.summary: SolarSquare Energy is running at least 3 active Meta ads targeting Hyderabad (creatives shared across 2, 6 and 2 ads), started 12, 13 and 16 October 2026. Unlike the local installers, these ads land on a page SolarSquare owns - solarsquare.in/rooftop-solar-in-hyderabad-1 - which carries Hyderabad-specific pricing (2 kW about Rs. 1.07 lakh to 5 kW about Rs. 2.65 lakh with subsidy, dated 01 October 2026), an EMI calculator, a free-consultation form and the GoodZero money-back savings plan. SolarSquare is a national brand (36,000+ homes, 31 cities across 10 states) and the Hyderabad landing page is one of many city pages. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: The click lands on a page SolarSquare owns and controls, which is the right shape: the page can carry a pixel, UTMs, a form and a testable headline. The open questions public data cannot answer are whether the pixel and UTM scheme are actually installed, and whether the Hyderabad page converts better than the 30 other city pages competing for the same spend.

findings: The ads land on SolarSquare's own Hyderabad landing page - the only lead in this batch where paid clicks reach a page the advertiser owns and can measure.
Multiple live creatives are running (bill-savings angle, money-back guarantee angle, free-consultation angle), so the account is already testing messages against each other.
The Hyderabad page carries a full pricing table dated 01 October 2026 with a 'subject to change' note - worth confirming those numbers still match current DISCOM charges before the next spend cycle.
The ads captured in these searches are all in English, while most Hyderabad competitors run Telugu-language creatives for the same subsidy audience - a language test is an obvious gap.

Public data cannot show whether the Hyderabad page carries the Meta Pixel and UTM scheme, what the spend is, or which creative is winning - that needs account access and is marked unknown in the control review.
next_steps: Verify pixel + UTM scheme on the Hyderabad page

Confirm the Meta Pixel fires on the Hyderabad landing page and that every ad carries UTMs, so the bill-savings, money-back and free-consultation creatives can be compared against each other on form fills, not clicks.
Run a Telugu creative for the Hyderabad market
Every ad captured is English while local competitors run Telugu subsidy ads - a Telugu version of the strongest creative tests an untapped audience.
Keep the Hyderabad pricing table current
The page's subsidy pricing is dated 01 October 2026 and flagged 'subject to change'; refreshing it (and dating it) keeps the offer credible.
Put the money-back guarantee above the fold
The GoodZero guarantee is the sharpest differentiator in the ad set - the landing page should lead with it, not bury it below the calculator.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
